items.rationale: Clause 5.2.2 covers locating the escape even though the pool pipework is excluded. The gross estimate for the single flat rate is €534, consistent with Case 63.
Clauses 4.3(b), 2.4.4 and 7.1.8(a) exclude repair of the pool coupling, even though the escape caused covered damage. The €339 figure is conditional only.
The description attributes the fitter's hours to remaking the excluded coupling, so clauses 7.1.8(a) and 7.1.10 bar payment. The conditional benchmark is €346 for all five hours.
The fittings are materials for repairing the excluded source installation and are not payable under clauses 2.4.4 and 7.1.8(a). The conditional gross benchmark is €137.
Clause 5.2.2 covers mapping the wetting and follow-up readings to confirm drying. The gross estimate is €232 for the single flat rate.
Extraction from the affected room is covered under clauses 5.2.1 and 7.1.7(b). The €313 gross estimate is below the €2,500 mitigation cap.

items.description: Set up and attend room drying
items.rationale: Clauses 7.1.5 and 7.1.7(b) cover drying the connected space because it was wetted throughout. The €571 gross flat rate covers setup and attendance, not the separately billed equipment rental.
Clause 7.1.7(b) covers necessary equipment rental during measured drying. The dryer was used for one day, at an estimated €60 gross.
Clause 7.1.7(b) covers the fan through the third-day readings that confirmed drying was complete. Three days at €27 gross gives €81.
The swollen fixed skirting is insured under clause 4.2.2, and like-for-like softwood replacement meets clauses 7.1.1 and 7.1.9. The gross estimate is €712 for 15 m, or about €47.47 per metre.
The scheduled loose-furnishings extension covers the soaked rug under clause 4.4, and clause 7.1.7(f) covers cleaning and drying it. The comparable Case 63 range of €218–€244 supports €231 gross.
The switch, socket and floor box were directly wetted and serve the building. Clauses 4.2.4 and 7.1.7(g) cover the necessary safety tests at an estimated €350 gross.
The pump and controls are excluded pool plant under clause 4.3(b), so their inspection is barred by clause 7.1.8(b) and does not qualify under 7.1.7(g). The €422 figure is conditional only.
Clauses 7.1.8(c) and 7.1.9 exclude the separately itemised upgrade in full. The conditional €1,560 is a benchmark for 12 m² of standard tile reinstatement, not an allowance on this line.
This is scheduled upkeep under clause 3.1.5 and concerns equipment excluded by clause 4.3(b). The €262 figure is conditional only.
Clauses 2.4.2 and 7.1.5 cover the wetted band only: about 20 m × 0.5 m = 10 m². At about €68.80 gross per m², the estimated total is €688.

items.description: Final cleaning of covered work area
items.rationale: Clause 7.1.7(h) covers final cleaning attributable to the covered works, not cleanup for the excluded upgrade or pool service. The €213 gross estimate is for the covered work area.
Clause 7.1.8(e) and section 11.3 allow one attendance charge on an invoice containing covered work. The single van charge is estimated at €83 gross.
